# Third-party notices

Voice Command AI is MIT-licensed (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)). Its desktop and mobile apps, server (`vcad`) and CLI (`vca`) include the open-source components listed below, each under its own license. Where a component offers a choice of licenses (for example `MIT OR Apache-2.0`), it is used under the license shown as its group; the declared expression is given next to it.

Each component is listed with its version, repository and the copyright notices found in its license files. The full text of every license used follows once at the end; for MIT, BSD, ISC and Zlib the copyright notices listed with each component complete the license text. A readable summary is in [docs/open-source.md](docs/open-source.md).

## Not bundled: reference tools, engines and model weights

- The reference servers in `tools/stt-server` (on top of faster-whisper and CTranslate2, MIT) and `tools/tts-server` (for MeloTTS, MIT, or Supertonic: code MIT, model weights OpenRAIL-M) are optional helpers that you install yourself. They are not part of the apps or their installers.
- No speech-to-text, text-to-speech or language model weights are shipped. Engines and models (local or cloud), and connectivity services such as DNSPilot, are provided and configured by the user.
- You are responsible for complying with the licenses and terms of the engines, models and services you install or connect, including any use restrictions or disclosure requirements.
